intro.title: Overview
intro.body:
Frontend-heavy Fullstack Engineer with 5 years of experience building enterprise websites, product platforms, ERP systems, and interactive web experiences.

My primary expertise is in Vue, Nuxt, React, JavaScript, and Node.js. I enjoy translating complex business requirements into maintainable systems, balancing performance, usability, and long-term scalability.

Beyond implementation, I work closely with designers, PMs, and backend engineers to deliver products that solve real user and business problems.

work.title: PROJECTS
work.summary: These selected projects highlight my real-world experience across modern web development. Each example includes a brief overview and live demo, demonstrating my ability to solve complex problems, work with different technologies, and deliver effective solutions.
work.description: Over the past 5 years, I’ve delivered 30+ web projects, from large-scale corporate websites and ERP systems to exhibition microsites and interactive digital experiences. I enjoy working at the intersection of frontend engineering, motion, and interaction—building experiences that are visually engaging, performant, and maintainable.

projects.title: Pay La (Shared Expense Web App)
projects.description: Mobile-first shared expense and settlement web application built with Next.js, Firebase.
highlight: Group-based expense tracking, split calculation, balance engine, and settlements
Static export deployment with GitHub Pages and custom domain

projects.title: Goodbye 1987 (Interactive Film Website)
projects.description: Interactive promotional website built with Nuxt, GSAP, and p5.js
highlight: Generative visuals and animations with p5.js
Interactive quiz with downloadable image & video results
projects.alt: Goodbye 1987 interactive film website project image

projects.title: Bai Bai 1.0 (CMS + Animation)
projects.description: Content-driven site built with WordPress + Nuxt

projects.title: Far Eastern New Century (Global Corporate Website)
projects.description: Contributed to the frontend development of a large-scale multilingual corporate website
highlight: Supported the delivery of a 90+ page enterprise platform
Built reusable components and page templates
Integrated WordPress CMS with i18n support
projects.alt: Far Eastern New Century project image

items.title: Frontend Engineer
points: Delivered 6 new projects and maintained 10+ existing websites, including government and enterprise platforms.
Implemented advanced animation solutions and optimized scroll-based interactions for smooth performance.
Supported i18n, A11y compliance, and security best practices, collaborating closely with designers and PMs.

items.title: Node. Js Engineer
points: Developed and maintained a large-scale student community platform serving web, iOS, and Android users.
Redesigned the messaging system from direct messages to threaded group conversations.
Separated backend APIs from full-stack system, optimized DB architecture, and authored ~75% of technical documentation.
Expanded operations platform with reporting, blocking, vote/board settings, account history, notifications, and scheduling.

items.title: Manager
points: Managed 3 branches and 10+ staff, strengthening leadership and communication.

items.title: Other Experience
points: 8 years in hospitality & 1 year in surveying; developed strong teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
